What we create We push the boundaries of what is possible, creating   solutions where none existed and building apps and   services that enable change.
How we operate We are committed to protecting what is truly important: The well-being of people and our planet.
•	Take bold climate action by minimizing our footprint, championing  renewable energy, restoring water resources, engaging our suppliers and  supporting climate justice.
•	Provide access to new ideas, accurate information and ways to take action  via content on our platforms.
•	Amplify content from scientists and climate action leaders.
•	Respect human, labor and civil rights in our operations and supply chain.
•	Design new apps and services with diverse needs and values in mind.
•	Cultivate diversity and inclusion in our operations.
•	Elevate small businesses and spur economic growth.
•	Boost energy and water efficiency in our data centers.
•	Integrate circular practices in our facilities and hardware.
•	Engage experts to guide our sustainability and  social impact initiatives.
•	Work with local power utilities to enable   our facilities and local businesses to procure  renewable energy.
How we collaborate We tackle the important  issues by creating partnerships and joining  established initiatives.
•	Share our environmental learnings and practices  throughout the tech industry and beyond.
•	Join forces with non-governmental organizations  (NGOs) and community organizations to create and  implement locally beneficial environmental initiatives.
